decision.rationale: An empty activity produces a revision without time_max. Retrieved tests assert statuses or populated fixtures, not this field’s absence after empty creation; nullable serialization alone cannot determine attribution.

scope.tests_and_docs: Package-local test directories, README/API prose and linked DTO/service/serialization files only.

manual_fallback.notes: ActivitiesIntegrationTest status hits are mostly GET/rating/favourites/PUT/DELETE. POST helpers use populated fixtures; fixture 2 is a name-only PATCH, not an empty-create response-field assertion. Data-batch crawler field tests concern ingestion and are not linked to this scenario.

coverage_resolution: Manual handler and field review supplements the lexical scan.
